scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.dev:watch: npm run build:node-server && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start" "npm run dev:web-app"
scripts.build: npm run build:web-app && npm run build:node-server
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --project-directory docker logs -f app
scripts.docker:import: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --project-directory docker exec -e IMPORT_FORCE=1 -e AUTO_IMPORT=1 app sh -c "rm -f /app/data/.mysql-imported; node /app/ops/scripts/import-mysql.mjs; touch /app/data/.mysql-imported"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p config/tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p config/tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p config/tsconfig.server.json
